snippet.title: FZ: Formation Z - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A legend transforms once again!
FZ: Formation Z will be coming on June 9th 2026! A modern revival of the classic shmup that transformed a generation.

Coming to Switch 2, PS5, Xbox, Steam and Epic Games Store!

Follow Clear River Games on X for updates: http://www.x.com/clearrivergames
